tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Only Manufacturers of Mirrors with minimum Annual average turnover of Rs.1.00 crore during the proceeding continuous three Years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24, & 2024-25 are eligible to participate duly supported by the Audited statements of accounts i.e., Manufacturing / trading and profit & loss account, Balance sheets for all the three years, the documents submitted must be certified by the chartered accountant and signed by the authorized signatory of the tenderer. The CA certificate as per prescribed format has to be submitted. They should furnish certificate of incorporation / Registration certificate /SSI Certificate / Document from the department of Industries and commerce.The bidder shall submit sample of all the tendered items for which the bid is being submitted and the samples of all the tendered items shall be submitted on or before last date of submission of bid documents (each 5 Nos sample). The sample of the bidders will be evaluated by the Mechanical Engineering Department, BMTC to verify their Specification. Only the commercial offers of the bidders whose sample are approved by the Mechanical Engineering Department will be considered for evaluation
